column1: To fix mwl8k firmware command serialisation properly
following requirements:
- Some commands require that the packet transmit path is idle when
the command is issued.  (For simplicity
transmit path for every command.)
- There are certain sequences of commands that need to be issued to
the hardware sequentially
This leads to an implementation of a ""firmware lock"" as a mutex that
can be taken recursively
column2: and which is taken by both the low-level

column1: command submission function (mwl8k_post_cmd) as well as any users of
that function that require issuing of an atomic sequence of commands
and quiesces the transmit path whenever it's taken.
